description_en: Creates an image search application instance
description_zh: 调用该接口创建以图搜图应用实例
kebab_example: aliyun linkvisual create-picture-search-app --name '以图搜图' --desc '以图搜图Demo' --iot-instance-id iot_instc_pu0000_c0-v6400000000 --api-version 2018-01-20 --region cn-hangzhou
name: CreatePictureSearchApp

parameters.help_en:
The name of the image search application instance. 

The name can contain Chinese characters, letters, digits, underscores (_), and hyphens (-). The name can be up to 64 characters in length. Each Chinese character counts as two characters
parameters.help_zh:
以图搜图应用实例的名称。 

支持中文汉字、英文大小写字母、数字、下划线（_）和短划线（-），长度不超过64个字符，一个汉字算2个字符
parameters.name: name

parameters.help_en:
The description of the image search application instance.

The description can contain Chinese characters, letters, digits, underscores (_), and hyphens (-). The description can be up to 1024 characters in length. Each Chinese character counts as two characters
parameters.help_zh:
以图搜图应用实例的描述信息。

支持中文汉字、英文大小写字母、数字、下划线（_）和短划线（-），长度不超过1024个字符，一个汉字算2个字符
parameters.name: desc

parameters.help_en:
The instance ID.

You can view the **ID** of the current instance on the **Instance Overview** page in the IoT Platform console. If the ID value exists, you must specify this parameter. Otherwise, the call fails.

> If the public instance does not have an ID value, refer to https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/267533.html
parameters.help_zh:
实例ID。

您可在物联网平台控制台的**实例概览**页面，查看当前实例的**ID**。若有ID值，必须传入该ID值，否则调用会失败。

> 如果公共实例没有ID值，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/267533.html
parameters.name: iot_instance_id
